title: Forgotten Waters
subtitle: The Cooperative App-Narrated Crossroads Pirate Campaign
tagline: Chart unknown tropical seas, follow colorful personal fortunes, and survive wild pirate adventures.
loreSummary: You are a colorful pirate crew sailing aboard a single vessel in a world of whimsical magic and nautical adventure. Using the rich voice-narrated web companion app, you will place crew members into vital ship roles, explore mysterious islands, confront sea monsters, and strive to complete your character's hilarious personal constellation sheet.
keyFeatures: Cooperative Crossroads storytelling powered by a fully voice-acted web companion app
Individual pirate sheets with humorous personal backstories and constellation objectives
Time-pressured action selection with unique ship roles (Quartermaster, Cooper, Gunner)
Rich storybook locations with branching narrative choices and high-stakes dice challenges

forgotten_waters_core_voyages.name: Core Pirate Chronicle (5 Scenarios)
forgotten_waters_core_voyages.description: All 5 extensive base game narrative scenarios spanning dozens of islands, leviathans, and pirate endings.

forgotten_waters_introductory_voyage.name: Introductory Voyages (2 Scenarios)
forgotten_waters_introductory_voyage.description: The first 2 introductory adventures ideal for learning ship roles, timing limits, and storybook navigation.

forgotten_waters_extended_expeditions.name: All Voyages & Expansion Quests (7 Scenarios)
forgotten_waters_extended_expeditions.description: The complete pirate saga including all 5 core voyages plus 2 downloadable DLC narrative expeditions.

milestones.title: Beyond the Ocean's Edge
milestones.description: Establish ship roles, master the app-driven narration, and chart unexplored tropical atolls.

milestones.title: Perils of the Abyssal Depths
milestones.description: Survive monstrous sea beasts, cursed skeleton galleons, and mutinous rum shortages on the open sea.

milestones.title: Legend of the High Seas
milestones.description: Complete personal pirate constellation sheets, claim legendary pirate booty, and write your immortal pirate ballad.
